description: A bearded man in a dark frock coat and top hat leans over a wooden barrel while thick black oil pours from a pipe into it. Behind him stand a tall wooden derrick, a small wooden engine house with a tall smokestack, and a few barrels. A figure crouches at left near the pipe. The scene is a dim, dusky forest clearing with smoke in the sky and a warm glow from the shed. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no border.
